user.title: ArkSignal weather
user.description: On ArkSignal open My Weather Stations, add a station and choose Home Assistant. Paste its upload address here (it ends in /wx/relay/ and a long secret).

device.title: Choose the weather station
device.description: Pick the device in Home Assistant that is your weather station (a Tempest, Ecowitt, Ambient, Davis or similar). Leave it empty to choose the sensors one by one.

sensors.title: Check the sensors
sensors.description: These were found automatically from the device you chose. Check each one and change or clear it. Leave a value empty if your station does not measure it. Units are sent as Home Assistant shows them; ArkSignal converts.

error.bad_address: That does not look like an ArkSignal upload address. It should look like http://host/wx/relay/ followed by a long secret.
error.unknown_address: ArkSignal does not know that address. Copy it again from My Weather Stations.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach ArkSignal. Check the address and that Home Assistant can reach the internet.
error.nothing_chosen: Choose at least one sensor or a weather entity.

abort.already_configured: That ArkSignal station is already set up.

init.title: ArkSignal weather
init.description: Change which sensors are sent, or how often.
